```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

#read_tables
C16 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR16_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C17 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR17_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C18 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR18_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C19 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR19_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C20 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR20_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C21 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR21_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C22 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR22_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C23 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR23_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C24 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR24_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C25 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR25_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")
C26 <- read.delim("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/bedfiles/IR26_window.bed", header= FALSE, sep="\t")

#put the tables into a list
tables <- list(C16, C17, C18, C19, C20, C21, C22, C23, C24, C25, C26)
#Add column names
new_colnames <- c(
  # IR bed columns
  "ir_chr", "ir_start", "ir_end",
  "ir_name", "ir_score", "ir_strand",
  # genes bed columns
  "gene_chr", "gene_start", "gene_end",
  "gene_name", "gene_score", "gene_strand"
)

#Label the columns 
colnames(C16) <- new_colnames
colnames(C17) <- new_colnames
colnames(C18) <- new_colnames
colnames(C19) <- new_colnames
colnames(C20) <- new_colnames
colnames(C21) <- new_colnames
colnames(C22) <- new_colnames
colnames(C23) <- new_colnames
colnames(C24) <- new_colnames
colnames(C25) <- new_colnames
colnames(C26) <- new_colnames

#Merge tables into one
combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(16:26, function(clone) {
  obj <- get(paste0("C", clone))
  obj$clone <- clone
  return(obj)
}))

#Classify gene as being within, upstream or downstream of IR. I asked HOPGPT which showed a the if then statement.
#If the IR is 
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    #RAW distance means it is not strand aware yet
    raw_distance = case_when(
      ir_start >= gene_start & ir_start <= gene_end ~ 0,
      ir_start < gene_start ~ ir_start - gene_start,
      ir_start > gene_end ~ ir_start - gene_end
    ),
    # strand aware (+ = downstream), (- = upstream)
    distance = case_when(
      raw_distance == 0 ~ 0, #Within gene
  
      # Positive strand gene
      # left of gene = upstream = negative
      # right of gene = downstream = positive
      gene_strand == "+" ~ raw_distance,
      
      # Negative strand gene
      # left of gene = downstream = positive
      # right of gene = upstream = negative
      gene_strand == "-" ~ -raw_distance
    ),
    # Add position label
    position = case_when(
      distance == 0 ~ "intragenic",
      distance > 0 ~ "downstream",
      distance < 0 ~ "upstream"
    )
  )

#Add a column for significance (if holms is less than 0.05)
#Break up the the gene_name column by '_'
#ENSID, baseMean, log2FC, lfcSE, pval, padj, gene_name, p_holm
combined <- combined %>%
  separate(col = gene_name,
           into = c("ENSID", "baseMean", "log2FC", "pval", "padj", "p_holm"),
           sep = "_")
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC),
    baseMean = as.numeric(baseMean),
    pval = as.numeric(pval),
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    p_holm = as.numeric(p_holm)
  )
#Add significance column
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_holm < 0.05, 
                      "significant", 
                      "not significant")
```

```{r}

plot_data <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(log2FC)) %>%
  filter(!is.nan(log2FC)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

# Check
summary(plot_data$log2FC)
```
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = distance/1000,
                      y = log2FC,
                      color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("significant" = "red",
                                "not significant" = "black"),
                     labels = c("significant" = "p < 0.05",
                                "not significant" = "p > 0.05")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             color = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Endogenous genes",
       x = "Distance from IR (kb)",
       y = "log2 (Fold change)",
       color = "") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-100, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-100, -50, 0, 50, 100),
                     labels = c("-100", "-50", "IR", "50", "100")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    
  )
```
